hard_rules: ABSOLUTELY NO category/archive/delete/move/merge decision because of zero, null, low, or missing SEO search volume. No volume threshold.
No provider result does NOT mean zero demand; treat as UNKNOWN.
Provider results for a term may suggest more natural wording, alternate names, search intent, or article angle, never automatic deletion.
Intermediate category stays if sufficient independently justified subcategories regardless of searched category heading; >=3 real children; unlimited above.
Leaf category stays if >=3 standalone substantial article intents (more allowed), clear category scope and ownership, regardless of volume.

Duplicated real search intent may require editorial de-duplication, but any change to an existing category ID, name, slug, URL or article must be individually approved and performed through the central category office.
SEO-friendly navigation name should be short, German, precise and human-readable; display/menu alias independent from SEO heading and unchanged canonical WP slug.
DataForSEO may inform an editorial decision but does not auto-mark SEO owner, PASS, approve renaming, or remove content.
Provider no-results/low-volume and a niche with high topical depth are NOT contradictions.
release_gate: KEEP ALL 285 existing CORE categories and 107 V99 candidates untouched during evidence evaluation. No WordPress writes; semantic owner/complete coverage and honest keyword naming review first.
